mapper.sql: grades.grade_id as "gradeId", grades.evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", grades.teacher_user_id as "teacherUserId", users.name as "teacherName", grades.college_code as "collegeCode", grades.department_code as "departmentCode", grades.completion_type_code as "completionTypeCode", grades.semester_code as "semesterCode", grades.course_area_code as "courseAreaCode", grades.course_area_name as "courseAreaName", grades.group_grade as "groupGrade", grades.total_score as "totalScore", grades.published_yn as "publishedYn", grades.finalization_status as "finalizationStatus", grades.updated_at as "updatedAt"
from course_area_group_evaluation_grades grades inner join users on users.user_id = grades.teacher_user_id
mapper.insert: insert into data_access_histories (target_business, viewer_user_id, target_scope, access_purpose, request_id) values (#{targetBusiness}, #{viewerUserId}, #{targetScope}, #{accessPurpose}, #{requestId})
